notes.title: 【Expo Announced】Meet The Battle Orks at WEPLAY!
notes.notes:
Dear Fellow Orks,

We’re back with exciting news to share! Our title, The Battle Orks, has been nominated for the "Best Game Jam Work" at IndiePlay award 2024! The award ceremony will be held as part of WePlay Expo—China's largest indie game expo.

WOW Studio Games will be attending with the latest version of The Battle Orks. 

Come and meet us at the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center (Hall H4, booths [color=#BA1FFF]A35[/color]  and [color=#BA1FFF]S01-54[/color] ) on November 16-17.

Play the latest version and join our playtest events with great prizes! 

[b]WEPLAY the Orks ![/b]

Together, let’s —
“LIVE LOUD, PLAY PROUD!”

notes.title: 【Project Kickoff】An Ork Game Born from Game Jam
notes.notes:
The Battle Orks was created during the 2024 China Game Jam 48-Hour Competition, originally titled The Limitless Boom. Inspired by the theme "Limited and Unlimited," we aimed to design a game that would spark endless fun for players within limited rules and time.

The game has undergone many changes and improvements since its early version. We even restructured the entire combat system. If you'd like to see what the early version looked like, check it out here: https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1qS421R7ad/.
